svg.title: The final project, from above
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the Module 2 final project. A taped circle has one short strip of tape across its line on the right-hand side: the cross, a little shorter than the robot is wide. The robot starts at the bottom of the circle and follows it to the cross. Its sensors reach the cross first and it stops; it drives forward to park its wheels on the cross, then makes two clockwise turns, first onto the strip and then onto the circle going the other way. It follows the circle all the way round the other way and meets the cross again from the other side, and reverses there the same way. Four reversals, and it stops. A panel beside it names each stage: following to the cross, cross detected and reversing, and done.
svg.text: 1. Follow the circle to the cross
2. Park on it and turn around
The cross is one short strip, just
long enough for both sensors to see
it, so the robot meets it once a lap:
all the way round, reverse, and
all the way round the other way.
